Good to know

A few small details.

What do I need to use Endless Crown?

An Apple Watch running watchOS 10 or later. Endless Crown is a Watch app; the Digital Crown is the main way you interact with it.

I bought it on my iPhone. Where is the app?

Endless Crown runs only on Apple Watch. You can purchase it from your iPhone, but it won’t add an app to your iPhone Home Screen. Once installed, open it from your Apple Watch’s app list. If it isn’t there yet, follow the installation steps below.

How do I install it on my Apple Watch?

On your Watch: Open the App Store, search for Endless Crown, and tap the price or cloud download button. Follow the prompts to install it.

Already purchased? In the App Store on your Watch, scroll to the bottom and open Account → Purchased. Choose My Purchases if shown, find Endless Crown, and tap the cloud download button. Use the Apple Account you purchased it with; you don’t need to pay again.

From your paired iPhone: Open the Watch app → My Watch. If Endless Crown appears under Available Apps, tap Install. If it isn’t listed, use the App Store on your Watch instead.

After installation, press the Digital Crown to see your apps, then tap Endless Crown.

Apple’s installation guide · Help redownloading a purchase

How do I change effects and settings?

Tap the number line or effect chip to cycle through effects. Touch and hold either one to open the Effects picker. Double-tap either one to open the menu, where you can change number formats, view statistics, reset, or adjust ambient mode.

Is there a subscription?

No. Endless Crown is a one-time purchase with no in-app purchases. The App Store shows the current price for your country or region.

What does ambient mode do?

Ambient mode dims the app’s interface for a more discreet appearance. Your Apple Watch still controls when its display dims or sleeps.

Can I open it from my watch face?

Yes. Add the Endless Crown complication to a compatible watch face for quick access. It can also show your current item and total haptic count.
